wrap_model_for_distributed_training: wrap a BaseFairseqModel with DistributedFairseqModel to support distributed data parallel training
configure_c10d_ddp_backend: configure the c10d DDP backend with device IDs and bucket capacity for distributed training
configure_legacy_ddp_backend: configure the no_c10d legacy DDP backend with world size and buffer size for distributed training
access_wrapped_model_attributes: access attributes on the wrapped model through the _DistributedFairseqModel __getattr__ forwarding
review_DistributedFairseqModel: review the DistributedFairseqModel function that wraps a model for distributed data parallel training with c10d or legacy backend
